name: Court of Orestes
description: A crumbling flooded crypt on the Khystonos River where the oracle Orestes is buried.

description_citations.text: "Katachthon Mountains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Khystonos River was partially blocked by a rockfall, revealing the Court of Orestes.
timeline.quote: After being partially blocked by a rockfall, its waters run low.
